kit.noMatches: Nothing matches this search. Clear the search or try another word.
kit.peekMissing: It may have been archived, or you may not have access. Close this panel and choose another item.

error.title: This page did not load
error.sentence: Something went wrong while reading this page. Try again; if it keeps failing, contact your administrator with the reference below.

errors.title: Not saved
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong and nothing was saved. Try again in a moment.
errors.notFound: You may not have access to change this, or it no longer exists. Ask an Admin for access, or reload the page.
errors.conflict: Another item already uses this name or code. Choose a different one.
errors.invalid: One of the values is not allowed. Check the highlighted fields and try again.
errors.refused: The system refused this change. Check the values and try again, or ask an Admin.
errors.capability_document_frozen: This document is frozen and can never change. Add a new document for the new version.
errors.jurisdiction_no_answer: No answer: the project's jurisdiction is unresolved or not yet populated in canon, so the permit engine cannot say which permits apply. Set a populated jurisdiction on the project first.
errors.permit_requirement_tracked: A Permit record already tracks this requirement. Open that record instead.
errors.inspection_signed_off: This inspection is signed off, so its results are frozen. Start a new inspection to record new findings.
errors.inspection_item_template: That item belongs to another template. Reload the inspection and try again.
errors.sod_approval_requester: The inspector cannot sign off their own inspection. Ask another person with sign-off rights.
errors.venue_location_pair: Enter both a latitude and a longitude, or leave both blank.
errors.venue_location_range: Latitude runs from -90 to 90 and longitude from -180 to 180.
errors.time_zone_unknown: That time zone is not in the IANA list. Choose one from the list.
errors.record_blocker_required: Name what is blocking the permit before you mark it Blocked.
errors.record_replan_reason_required: Give a replan reason before you defer the permit.
errors.record_title_grammar: The title must name the permit as a noun phrase, without closing punctuation.
errors.record_transition_not_allowed: That state change is not allowed from the current state. Choose one of the offered states.
errors.record_state_conflict: Someone changed this record a moment ago. Reload to see the current state, then try again.
errors.transition_reason_required: Give a reason for the state change.
errors.production_closed: This project's production is closed, so nothing new can be added to it.
errors.enumeration_domain: That result is not one of the canon inspection results. Choose one from the list.
errors.fileTooLarge: Files can be at most 50 MB. Choose a smaller file.
errors.fileScanning: This file is still being scanned. Try the download again in a minute.
errors.site_plan_locked: This plan is locked or live. Unlock it to change its layout.
errors.site_plan_archived: This plan is archived. Reopen it as a draft to rename or change it.
errors.site_plan_no_drawing: Upload and use a drawing on the plan before you lock it or make it live.
errors.site_plan_live_exists: Another plan of this project, venue and level is live. Move it back to locked first.
errors.site_plan_transition_not_allowed: A plan cannot make that move from its state. Choose one of the actions offered.
errors.site_plan_state_conflict: Someone changed this plan's state. Reload the page and try again.
errors.site_plan_initial_state: A new plan starts as a draft.
errors.site_plan_transition_rpc_only: Change the plan's state with its state actions.
errors.site_plan_level_venue: Choose a level of the venue the plan draws, or choose the venue first.
errors.space_level_venue: Choose a level of the space's own venue.
errors.venue_level_reorder: Reload the page; the venue's levels changed while you were ordering them.
errors.venue_level_venue_immutable: A level stays with its venue. Add a new level to the other venue.
errors.site_plan_drawing_subject: Upload the drawing on this plan, then use it.
errors.site_plan_drawing_scan: The drawing is still being checked for viruses, or failed the check. Use it once it is Clean.
errors.site_plan_drawing_type: Use a PNG, JPEG or PDF file as the drawing.
errors.site_plan_raster_required: A PDF drawing needs the image of its page. Upload the PDF again so its page is rendered.
errors.site_plan_raster_attachment: Upload the PDF again so its page image is its own file.
errors.site_plan_drawing_page: Choose the page of the PDF that is the drawing.
errors.site_plan_drawing_classification: A drawing must be Public or Internal. Keep a Confidential or Restricted file as an ordinary attachment.
errors.site_plan_dimensions_fixed: A drawing's size is measured when it is set. Upload the drawing again to change it.
errors.site_plan_shape_geometry: The shape needs a label and must lie inside the drawing: a line with length, or an area that does not cross itself.
errors.site_plan_shape_plan_immutable: A shape stays on its plan. Draw it again on the other plan.
errors.site_plan_anchor: Choose a point on the drawing for the note.
errors.drawing_orientation: This JPEG is stored sideways and turned by its camera setting. Export it upright, then upload it again.
errors.drawing_dimensions: The drawing is larger than 20000 pixels on a side. Export a smaller image and upload it again.
errors.fileInfected: The virus check refused this file. Upload a clean copy.
errors.place_spec_target: A space's specs belong to the space's own venue.
errors.place_spec_document_venue: Choose a capability document of the same venue.
errors.place_spec_capability_managed: This capability comes from the venue's specs. Change the specs, then add them as capabilities again.
errors.project_no_venue: Choose the project's venue first; its specs become the capabilities.
errors.sign_pin_project: Place the sign on a pin of a site plan of its own project.
errors.sign_po_line_project: Link a line of a purchase order of this project that is not canceled.
errors.sign_po_line_read: Linking a purchase order line needs access to the project's purchase orders. Ask someone in procurement.
errors.sign_artwork_subject: Upload the artwork on this sign, then choose it.
errors.sign_step_rpc_only: Mark a sign ordered, printed or placed with its step actions.
errors.sign_ordered_by_po: This sign is ordered through its purchase order line.
errors.sign_ordered_manually: This sign is marked ordered. Undo Mark ordered first, then link the order line.
errors.sign_placed_needs_location: Give the sign a pin or a location before you mark it placed.
errors.sign_project_immutable: A sign stays in its project. Add it to the other project instead.

fields.name: Enter a name of 1 to 200 characters.
fields.title: Enter a title of 1 to 200 characters.
fields.jurisdiction: Choose the jurisdiction the venue sits in.
fields.locationPair: Enter both a latitude and a longitude, or leave both blank.
fields.positive: Enter a number above zero, or leave it blank if it is not known.
fields.wholePositive: Enter a whole number above zero, or leave it blank if it is not known.
fields.zoneCode: Use 1 to 16 capital letters, digits or hyphens, starting with a letter or digit.
fields.documentUri: Enter where the document is stored.
fields.imageUri: Enter where the drawing is stored.
fields.validity: The last valid day cannot be before the first.
fields.label: Enter a label of 1 to 200 characters.
fields.percent: Enter a position from 0 to 100 percent.
fields.direction: Choose whether this is required or provided.
fields.provider: Choose the venue that provides it.
fields.reason: Give a reason for the change.
fields.blocker: Name what is blocking the permit.
fields.prompt: Describe what is checked in 1 to 500 characters.
fields.scalePoints: Choose exactly two points for the known distance.
fields.distance: Enter the real distance, above zero.
fields.page: Choose a page of the PDF.
fields.levelOrder: Enter a whole number from -20 to 200.
fields.levelName: Another level of this venue has that name. Choose another.
fields.tooLong: Shorten this to the length shown.
fields.invalid: Enter a number of zero or more, or leave it blank if it is not known.
fields.signQuantity: Enter a whole number from 1 to 10000.
fields.signSize: Enter a size above zero, at most 1200 inches.
fields.artworkType: Use a PNG, JPEG or PDF file.

documents.freezeBody: A frozen document can never be edited or unfrozen. Later changes need a new document.

confirm.lock: Locking fixes the pins, shapes, scale and drawing. Comments stay open.
confirm.unlock: Unlocking lets people change the layout again.
confirm.makeLive: The live plan is the one crews work from. Only one plan per venue and level is live.
confirm.backToLocked: The plan stops being the one crews work from.
confirm.reopen: The plan becomes a draft that can be changed again.
confirm.archive: An archived plan is retired and read-only. Reopen it as a draft to change it.

drawing.classified: The drawing's file is now classified above Internal, so it is not shown here or printed. The plan shows its frame instead.
drawing.removed: The drawing's file was removed, so the plan shows its frame. Upload the drawing again to draw on it.
drawing.sizeMismatch: The drawing's size does not match what was measured when it was set, so measuring and the scale are off. Upload the drawing again.
drawing.drawingForbidden: You cannot view this drawing. Verify your sign-in again, or ask for access to the plan's files.
drawing.drawingFailed: The drawing did not load. Reload the page; if it keeps failing, upload the drawing again.
drawing.legacyNotice: Upload the drawing to draw, measure and export the plan with it.
drawing.help: PNG, JPEG or PDF. From a PDF, the page you choose becomes the drawing.
drawing.oldFrame: The pins on this plan were placed on the old frame. Check them once the drawing is set; some may need moving.

reconciliation.title: Requirements and Capability
reconciliation.intro: List what the production requires and what venues provide, then reconcile. A requirement with no claim, or only an UNKNOWN claim, reconciles as Unknown, never Met; a Gap or an Unknown on a critical requirement is a gate 3 gap.
reconciliation.neverRun: Not reconciled yet. Add requirements and capabilities, then run a reconciliation.
reconciliation.gapsTitle: {count, plural, one {# gate 3 gap} other {# gate 3 gaps}}
reconciliation.gapsBody: Close each gap with a capability that covers it, or record a stronger claim, then reconcile again.
reconciliation.noGaps: No gate 3 gaps in the latest reconciliation.
reconciliation.noRequirements: No requirements yet. Add what the production needs below.
reconciliation.noCapabilities: No capabilities yet. Add what a venue provides below.

fields.critical: Critical: an Unknown here is a gate 3 gap
fields.assertionHelp: From canon: certified is strongest, unknown means no claim.
